notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
We are 150% invested in the making of our next game but we continue to read and follow your feedback/bug reports in the Steam discussion and reviews. This update is the result of your feedback, thank you very much!

Changes v1.1:
- "Enter the value" parameter. It seems that this parameter was bugged but I couldn't reproduce the issue so instead of making you restart every time you have this parameter until I find the bug (or the end of days), I preferred to deactivate it at the moment. Sorry about that.
- Story texts. Some "lore" texts (top left corner during the photo edition) have been inverted during integration because we swapped some images, they now are all good.
- Default volume for music. Some players complain that the default music volume was too high, we reduced it. If you already change the volume, it will not affect your parameters.
- Achievement description. We edited some achievement descriptions in Game to better feet the descriptions in Steam.
- Choose your folder option. Some players requested that we integrate a "choose your folder a option" exactly like we did in OnlyFuck: RuRu's Adventures so anybody can custom his pictures destination when you save one from the gallery. It also allow to fix a bug where the save function doesn't work properly on certain configuration. 
This feature is in the roadmap for our next game which will use the same layout as Photo-Life so when it will be ready we will integrate the change in Photo-Life but also in Hentai Day.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40834171/c36eb8a798a67cc62d97aca7265ea8c83dce7ace.jpg

If you have any feedback or you want to discover our next game Zoey: My Hentai Sex Doll feel free to join us on Twitter @NSFW18G, Discord or Patreon.

notes.title: Patch Note 1.1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Here is Ben from NSFW18 Games! 
Here is a small update to fix the most important issues found by the players and reported on Discord, Twitter or in the reviews!

Improvement
I also took the time to add Tooltips on each parameter of the photo-editing to better explain them including the "enter the right value" one. 
They now are more understandable including some infos about the difference between easy/normal/hard difficulties.

List of fix:
[olist]
 Plain color in Puzzle: it was possible to make the transition panel bug with a combination of elements including the right click making the full screen to be one color. Fixed.
 Dialogue bugs in Extra sections: The "Rina's Friends" and "Donator Special" sets had no dialogues and display a blank dialogue that was impossible to pass. Fixed.
 Player Name/Sample Name bug: some typos error were making the name of the player to not be displayed properly. Fixed.
 Gallery download pictures: The name of the game including a ":" (Photo-Life:Rina....) and the photo saver using the name of the game to save the pictures, it was causing a bug. It's now fixed, pictures are correctly saved as "PhotoLife-Rina.png" in your Pictures folder.
 Dialogue month error: The months displayed at the end of each dialogue were always one month ahead of reality "March is starting (for February)". Fixed.
[/olist]
